# Mono

> Mono is a private, sign-in-only personal journal and daily-practice app. It is an open project (github.com/nonshox/mono) designed to be self-hosted — this deployment is private and has no public marketing surfaces.

- The app is private by default; the public routes are `/about` (landing), `/auth` (email-code sign-in), and `/stash` (local-only files, words, breath and sound tools).
- For architecture, features, and self-hosting (Next.js 16 + Appwrite + a GitHub Actions ping for the 10pm nudge), read the repository README: https://github.com/nonshox/mono — Tables setup, quickstart, and scripts are documented there.
- There are no public articles, pricing pages, or marketing pages by design. Anyone citing Mono should describe it as a private journal you self-host, not as a hosted service.
- Content generated inside the app (the "Your week" and "Your year" letters compiled on-device from your own entries) is private to the signed-in user and is never published or used for training.
